subject: Clarify SOC 2 scope + request for Type II report and temporary attestation
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Miller <claire.miller@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Clarify SOC 2 scope + request for Type II report and temporary attestation

Hi Claire —

Great talking earlier. Quick recap / asks so we can move the compliance review forward: 

- Scope: Novamed is primarily interested in our hosted API for patient-facing triage workflows (prod region: us-west-2). Confirm if you want Redwood-hosted logging enabled for the pilot or if logs must stay off.
- Evidence: Please share the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month window) and any bridge letter or interim attestation you rely on for vendors. If you can provide portal access to a secure evidence locker (TrustHub or SFTP), that would speed validation.
- Regulatory checks: Let us know any HIPAA BA considerations and specific GDPR data transfer questions; we flagged data residency in our demo.
- Vendor questionnaire: happy to complete your DDQ — can you send the latest spreadsheet?

Next steps from our side: I’ll run this back with Marissa (security) to prep any clarifying Qs and share a draft bridge letter we use for temporary attestations. Can you confirm an internal deadline for your procurement/compliance review?

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: Claire Miller <claire.miller@novamed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Security <security@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify SOC 2 scope + request for Type II report and temporary attestation

Jonas —

Thanks for the recap. A few quick clarifications from security: 

1) We do need access to the SOC 2 Type II report covering the last audit period (anything older than 18 months is less helpful). A bridge letter is acceptable as an interim measure if the report is in process.

2) For the pilot, we can accept logs being retained by Redwood for 30 days in us-west-2, but any exported data must be encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys — is KMS/HSM supported?

3) I attached our DDQ template (novamed-ddq-questions.xlsx). Please have your security team fill the security controls section and return by EOD next Wednesday (2026-12-08) if possible — that’s our internal gating date.

4) NDA — we need a countersigned copy before sharing some of the more detailed architecture diagrams. We uploaded a signed copy to your TrustHub invite if you can accept it.

Claire
Claire Miller
Director, Security & Compliance — Novamed
claire.miller@novamed.com

Attachment: novamed-ddq-questions.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Miller <claire.miller@novamed.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify SOC 2 scope + request for Type II report and temporary attestation

Claire —

Appreciate the clear asks. A few notes from our side: 

- KMS/HSM: yes, Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS integrations for Private deployments; for Hosted API we offer KMS-backed encryption of logs and can discuss bringing a dedicated key for Novamed in a Dedicated plan.

- SOC 2: attaching a draft bridge letter we use for customers awaiting the annual report (redwood-bridge-letter-draft.pdf). If that helps you proceed to procurement faster, happy to sign.

- DDQ: we’ll complete the Novamed DDQ and return by your 2026-12-08 gating date. Expect a preliminary pass by Aditya tomorrow.

- TrustHub: thanks for uploading the NDA — I see a TrustHub invite link in your note, but I couldn’t find the signed PDF. If you already uploaded it, can you forward a direct link? Otherwise attaching our standard temporary attestation template for your review.

Jonas — can you confirm whether we should provision temporary SFTP or accept TrustHub for evidence exchange?

Best,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Head of Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Attachment: redwood-bridge-letter-draft.pdf
From: Claire Miller <claire.miller@novamed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify SOC 2 scope + request for Type II report and temporary attestation

Marissa / Jonas —

Quick update: we provisioned the TrustHub invite (https://drive.redwood.com/secure/Novamed-TrustHub-invite) and uploaded the countersigned NDA (NDA-signed-novamed.pdf). We prefer TrustHub for document exchange — please upload your bridge letter there and we’ll route to procurement.

One ask on the bridge letter: please include a short paragraph confirming the audit window for the Type II report you’re referencing (start/end dates) and whether any subservice orgs are in-scope. Procurement will need that explicit language.

We’ve also flagged that KMS requirement; if you can confirm the supported key management options in the DDQ answer sheet that will cover the technical control questions.

I’ll expect the DDQ back by EOD 2026-12-08. Thanks for the quick turnaround so we can keep the pilot timeline.

Claire

Attachment: nda-signed-novamed.pdf
